    To find the channel for a specific game:
    • Check the Team's Official Site: NBA.com/timberwolves has viewing info. 
    • Check Regional Sports Networks: For local viewers, FanDuel Sports Network North (Bally Sports North) or KARE 11 (free over-the-air) often carries games. 
    • National Broadcasts: Games can appear on ABC, ESPN, NBA TV, or Prime Video. 
    • Streaming: Fubo or ESPN App are options. 
    Since broadcast details change, always check the schedule for the specific game you want to watch, but for today's game, ABC is the main channel.
